note: Ceilings for `bun run check:ui` (issue #2580). Recorded from a real run on this machine — see the PR. The floors this lane is FOR are cardsOcc 0, ctrlsStranded 0 and axeSerious/axeCritical 0; where a surface breaks one of those TODAY the entry keeps the measured value and carries a `knownDebt` note naming the defect, printed under every run. A slice that fixes a surface lowers its ceilings in the same PR. A surface nobody can walk yet is `{"status":"unwalked","reason":…}` — listed in the output and in the coverage line, never silently green. Issue #2582 (PR #2619) moved the probe's `occ`/`reachable` boundary, and it moved it in BOTH directions. A control is `occ` when the centre of its VISIBLE INTERSECTION with (viewport n its own SCROLL PORT) hit-tests to something else, and `reachable` when that intersection is EMPTY but a gesture can bring it back — see `probe.js`'s `scrollPort` / `probe`. The old rule tested the element's raw centre against the bare viewport. LOOSER than the old rule: a control lying wholly outside its port's box (the deck-builder's off-strip `Delete column MV n` buttons) is no longer `occ`, and neither is one straddling a port's clip edge with a band below it (the lobby's `Your Events (all)` under the new bottom nav) — `<main>` paints nothing there, so nothing can be occluding it. STRICTER than the old rule: a control PARTLY clipped by its port is now hit-tested over the strip it still paints, where a raw centre would have been thrown away as out-of-window (`design-system-dialog`'s section-08 Cancel/Confirm specimens), and a `position: fixed` box gets no port at all rather than borrowing an ancestor scroller's rectangle. Rows re-recorded against the corrected probe carry the measurement and its enumeration in their own note. `deck-builder` was re-recorded whole on 2026-08-20 (issue #2585 fixup, PR #2650): the filter controls leaving the header band for a sheet/popover freed real height at every viewport, and a follow-up fixup (search bar `min-w-0 overflow-hidden`, Filters button icon-only under `short-viewport:`) closed a same-day regression at `844x390x3` where the new Filters button wrapped the header onto two full-height rows and pushed the Maindeck's Delete-column row under `SaveDeckBar` (`ctrlsOcc` 2 → 5 mid-fix → 1 final). Rows not re-recorded still measure below their number and are deliberately left alone: those readings vary with the deployment's own deck/pool data, and the notes on them describe debt the surface's own slice owns.

844x390x3.knownDebt: Re-recorded 2026-08-20 (issue #2585 fixup, PR #2650). Phone LANDSCAPE opens filters as a bottom sheet (`useSurfaceClass` phone branch), so this cell measures the header's own action row, not the sheet. `ctrlsOcc 1`: the search box (`search-bar.tsx`) -- at this width the header row (Back/Import/Export/Format select/Cube filter/Search/Filters) has no spare width left once the Filters button (issue #2585) joins it, so the box's flex item shrinks toward 0 and its `<input>` (whose intrinsic min-content width the browser holds near 34px regardless) would otherwise paint over the Filters button; the wrapper now carries `overflow-hidden` so that clips instead of occluding it. The probe hit-tests the `<input>`'s own layout rect because its `overflow-hidden` ancestor is not a SCROLL port (`scrollPort()` only recognises `auto`/`scroll`) -- a real pointer still reaches Filters cleanly, so this is not stranded. Before this fixup the cell measured `ctrlsOcc 5`: the header's action row wrapped the new Filters button onto a second full-height line (its label was un-collapsed text, unlike its `Stats` sibling), pushing the Maindeck's `Delete column <Lands|MV 0..3>` row down into `SaveDeckBar`'s band -- verified against `origin/main` at the same account/deck state, which measured `ctrlsOcc 0` there, so this was a genuine regression, not a legitimate new count. Fixed by hiding the Filters label under `short-viewport:` (icon-only, matching `Stats`) plus the search-bar clip above. 1 axe serious (scrollable-region-focusable), pre-existing.
